post_meta.author: meadowfire_m
post_meta.title: Piute Pass 6/5
post_meta.text: Piute 6/5. Snow starts just past Loch Leven, continuous to the pass, but it is the gentle kind, spikes in the morning and bare boots after lunch. Humphreys Basin is a sea of white. North Fork crossings all have snow bridges still, watch the thin ones near the lake.

facts.text: Nearby snow sensors read 8.6 in of water in the snowpack, melting fast (0d old).
Satellite (modeled) shows 69% snow cover in the pass bowl, last clear look 1d ago.
1 party reported from this pass recently; calibrated read: some snow, manageable.
North Fork Bishop Creek / Piute Creek gauge reads 92 cfs and dropping.

extraction.quote_span: the snow got continuous and we only had trail runners

post_meta.author: dayhiker_deb
post_meta.title: Piute Pass attempt
post_meta.text: Tried Piute Pass on Monday with my sister. We turned around at Piute Lake because the snow got continuous and we only had trail runners. A nice man with an ice axe said the top was fine but we did not feel good about it. The creek at the first crossing was over my knees.

facts.text: Nearby snow sensors read 5.4 in of water in the snowpack, melting steadily (0d old).
Satellite (modeled) shows 51% snow cover in the pass bowl, last clear look 2d ago.
1 party reported from this pass recently; calibrated read: some snow, manageable.
Worst reported crossing nearby: thigh high.
North Fork Bishop Creek / Piute Creek gauge reads 86 cfs and dropping.
Nearby snow sensors read 5.2 in of water in the snowpack (0d old).
Satellite (modeled) shows 50% snow cover in the pass bowl, last clear look 1d ago.
North Fork Bishop Creek / Piute Creek gauge reads 68 cfs and dropping.

extraction.quote_span: Only a few snow patches left near the top and you can walk around all of them

post_meta.author: dayhiker_deb
post_meta.title: Piute Pass redemption
post_meta.text: Went back to Piute on the 26th and made it this time! Only a few snow patches left near the top and you can walk around all of them. The crossing that stopped me in June is ankle deep now. So happy. Thank you to everyone who posted conditions here, this forum got me over my first pass.
